review_locator: PMCID:PMC4449733, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells in the Lung
primary_title: Lung natural helper cells are a critical source of Th2 cell-type cytokines in protease allergen-induced airway inflammation
decision_basis: The lung ILC2 review cites the primary report that IL-33 plus IL-2 stimulates lung natural-helper cells to produce IL-5; the primary measures cytokine production from the defined lung innate-lymphoid population.
limitations_preserved: Measured IL-5 production after combined IL-33 and IL-2 stimulation is supported in the defined mouse lung natural-helper population; preserve the cell markers and co-stimulation context and do not infer an unmeasured Il5 transcription-to-protein step, receptor stoichiometry, human equivalence, SCI transfer or terminal-TF mechanism.
